examples.title: Unread item
examples.description: Notification that still needs user attention.
examples.behavior: Unread emphasis helps scan priority without changing layout.
examples.qa: Unread marker is visible beyond color alone.

examples.title: Read item
examples.description: Notification already acknowledged by the user.
examples.behavior: Reduce emphasis while keeping enough context for history.
examples.qa: Read rows remain clickable if they open detail.

examples.title: Selected item
examples.description: Item selected in a master-detail inbox.
examples.behavior: Selected state points to the detail pane without looking like unread urgency.
examples.qa: Selected and unread states are distinguishable.

examples.title: Attention item
examples.description: Notification reports a failure that needs inspection.
examples.behavior: Use failure tone only for actionable or important system issues.

selected.trigger: Item is selected in a list
selected.qa: Selected does not look like unread.

archived.trigger: Item moved out of active inbox
